children: Orchid Island Capital declared a $0.10 per-share September dividend and disclosed August 31, 2026 RMBS portfolio characteristics.
Board declared monthly cash dividend of $0.10 per common share, payable Oct 29, 2026 to holders of record Sep 30, 2026 (ex-dividend Sep 30).
Company provided preliminary RMBS portfolio metrics as of Aug 31, 2026, including $11,154,454k fair value of mortgage assets.
Agency split: Fannie Mae 52.1% and Freddie Mac 47.9% of mortgage assets as of Aug 31, 2026.
Whole-pool exposure was 96.0% and non-whole pool 4.0% of mortgage assets per the Investment Company Act whole pool test.
Total borrowings were $10,704,987k as of Aug 31, 2026 with a weighted average repo rate of 3.77% and weighted maturity of 14 days.
